cite.locator: Omaha Beach § Breakthrough § Assaulting the bluffs (oldid 1388011462)

summary.text: German strongpoint (Widerstandsnest) at Saint-Laurent-sur-Mer that defended the E-1 draw off Omaha Beach. On D-Day the 3rd Battalion, 116th RCT climbed the bluff between WN-66 and WN-65, and by 09:00 the defenders of WN-62 wrongly reported that WN-65 and WN-66 had fallen. Wikidata records a surviving reinforced-concrete bunker at the site.
